alt: Poster: Jio Platforms IPO price band Rs 1,065-1,119, issue size Rs 30,213 crore, 27 crore fresh shares; Sensex 73,249.39 and Nifty 22,687.65 at close on 22 Oct 2026
text:
Today's market talking point: the Rs 30,213 crore Jio Platforms IPO is in its bidding window, on a day when Indian indices closed lower.

• Price band is Rs 1,065 to Rs 1,119 per equity share, per Upstox and Inc42.
• The book-built issue is Rs 30,213 crore, entirely a fresh issue of up to 27 crore equity shares with no offer-for-sale component; bidding closes on 23 October, per Upstox and Inc42.
• Sensex closed at 73,249.39, down 460.30 points (0.62%), and Nifty 50 at 22,687.65, down 123.70 points (0.54%), per Business Standard and IIFL.
• Nifty Smallcap 100 fell about 1.1% and Nifty Midcap 100 about 0.9%, with Nifty IT down about 1.3-1.4%, per Business Standard and IIFL.

Our view: a very large issue arriving on a weak market day shows how much liquidity and attention a single event can absorb. Subscription numbers move through the bidding window, and how listings perform afterwards is uncertain. This is an opinion about the data, not a prediction, and we do not recommend applying to or avoiding any issue.

For practitioners: when a mega IPO coincides with a soft tape, how do you help clients separate IPO headlines from their long-term asset allocation?
